data_dictionary.topics: One factual topic record per material section; recurring project references are not unique-project counts.

data_dictionary.table_fields: Seven factual fields plus a null legacy next_action compatibility key. The dashboard displays summary_points as bullets.
data_dictionary.latest_update_date_iso: YYYY-MM-DD only when the source date is a single, unqualified date. Otherwise null; use latest_update_date for the complete wording.

data_dictionary.source_refs: Internal source ranges for validation and changed-section comparison; hidden in the dashboard.

data_dictionary.headline_metrics: Section-wise headline facts, with company/project labels, units, dates and explanatory detail. Costs, receipts, pending work and physical progress remain separate measures.
data_dictionary.value_qualifier: Optional qualifier such as approximate or at_least; display_value retains the original qualification.
data_dictionary.display_update_date: Concise actual update date for display; empty when unavailable. Never substitute the generation date.
data_dictionary.structured_summary: Additive factual topic structure; targets/achievements/financials are references to typed values in comparison_tables. Legacy text fields remain compatible.
data_dictionary.comparison_tables: Explicit company/project rows with typed values, units, financial/physical roles and actual per-measure dates. Details and subtotals are not additive together.
data_dictionary.recorded_directives: Source-recorded instructions only; not recommendations. Hidden by default. Never infer the issuer or meeting date.
data_dictionary.report_layout: Agenda order, unique primary topic placement, related-topic links and print hints for a dashboard/PDF renderer; no PDF is generated.

executive_summary.text:

Phase I began commercial operation on 26 February. At Pirpainti, physical progress was 15% and financial progress 6% on 30 September.
On 13 November, Chhapra New GSS was 72% complete and its evacuation package 69%. Bagaha GSS reached 89%; its first 50-MVA transformer was charged on 7 November. Work on ten Patna GIS bus-sectionalizers reached 85%.
AIIMS Darbhanga: the land-proposal file was put up on 9 November. BSPTCL reports 83 of 88 substations retrofitted and 25 GSS complete in all respects. At MCC-I Patna, 15 of 25 acceptance tests were offered during 25 October–10 November; five passed and ten passed with comments. The MCC-II Gaya power-supply tests were completed.
